meta.title: Global AI Adoption Index
meta.description: Composite country-level index (0-100) blending enterprise AI adoption, generative-AI consumer usage, government readiness, talent & skills, and AI investment / infrastructure. Estimates are projected from the most recent published sources and should be treated as directional, not authoritative.

sources.name: Oxford Insights - Government AI Readiness Index 2024
Stanford / Ipsos - Global GenAI Usage Survey 2024-2025

meta.methodology: Composite = 0.30 enterprise_adoption + 0.20 consumer_genai_use + 0.20 government_readiness + 0.15 talent_skills + 0.15 investment_infrastructure. All sub-scores normalised 0-100 from latest published values, with linear extrapolation through Q1 2026 using 2023->2024 deltas. Composite values are estimates.

fields.ai_startups: Estimated number of active AI-focused companies
